name: Trips to Win (5 Card Draw)
description: Trips to Win: Five Card Draw variant. To win at showdown you must hold at least three of a kind (trips). Otherwise the hand is a push and the pot carries over.

overview.description: Trips to Win: Five Card Draw variant. To win at showdown you must hold at least three of a kind (trips). Otherwise the hand is a push and the pot carries over.

history.origins: Trips to Win is a qualifier variant of Five Card Draw Jacks or Better that requires at least three of a kind to win the pot, reducing bluffing and ensuring the winner has a real hand. It shares the same American draw-poker lineage as Five Card Draw and Jacks or Better and is a standard home and dealer's choice variant.

setup.players: Two to six players; six is recommended for the best game. More than six risks running out of cards during the draw.
setup.deck: Standard 52-card pack; one full deck, no jokers. Same as base Five Card Draw.

rules.objective: Best hand wins only if it is at least three of a kind; else push, pot carries.
rules.gameplay: As Five Card Draw; at showdown, best hand wins only if it qualifies (trips or better). If no one has trips, no winner; pot rolls to next hand.
keyRules: Must have trips or better to win

strategy.basic: Draw for trips; don't bluff into a qualifier.

scoring.winCondition: Best hand wins only if it is at least three of a kind; else push, pot carries.
